name: front-walk
description: The foreground (WM_ROM_OUT/front of rom.test.tsx, rom/frontFixture.ts, wm_data 29): the spec level with three lamp posts in front at 150, 200 and 120 % of the camera's speed. Player 1 runs right so the camera passes all three; every checkpoint shows them where draw_front puts them (screen x = 192 + (x - cam x - 192) * speed / 100), in front of the players and the enemies, in their one sprite palette.
